elements.label: Figure 7.1
elements.title: Neural networks are central to modern AI, especially in the fields of deep learning and machine learning.
elements.details: Image shows a stylized digital illustration of a microchip with circuit lines branching out symmetrically, resembling a neural network or brain structure.
elements.summary: This decorative figure visually represents the concept of neural networks as central to AI, inspired by the human brain's structure and functioning.
